verdict.rationale: The founder describes Zero as an AI-powered email client where users can chat with their inbox and have it draft replies, summarize threads and auto-categorize mail. The repo calls it an 'open-source AI email solution', and MCP.md lists AI-assisted composing and mailbox Q&A. But first-party documentation of an in-app assistant that takes delegated actions (beyond drafting and answering questions) is absent, and the action list is documented only as an MCP surface for external agents. Missing for 10: first-party docs for the in-app assistant, evidence it can carry out multi-step tasks or actions such as labeling, archiving or sending, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
